Lemma
[Growth of the rescaled pressure] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0128 1. ch29:29.39\group Backward Geometry

For the pole-normalized Euclidean pressures $\overline v_i$, there is a uniform constant $C$ such that \[ -C\le \log \overline v_i(r,\theta ,0)\le C(1+r^2) \qquad \text{on }\mathbb R^2. \]
